label: Gree PV Surplus
info:
Controls the Gree air conditioner based on SOC, battery voltage and temperature.

After import:
1. Battery SOC node:     Service = Venus system, Path = /Dc/Battery/Soc
2. Battery State node:   Service = Venus system, Path = /Dc/Battery/State
3. Battery Voltage node: Service = Venus system, Path = /Dc/Battery/Voltage
4. Ruuvi Inside node:    select inside sensor
5. Ruuvi Outside node:   select outside sensor (optional)
6. Deploy

Outside-temperature logic (if a sensor is present):
  Outside < 20C  switch-on temp +3C (ventilation is enough)
  Outside 20-30C switch-on temp as configured
  Outside > 30C  switch-on temp -2C (cool earlier)

name: External sensors
info: Generic sensor-injection entry point feeding 'Collect Data'. The simulator's mock sensor pump (Mocks tab) targets this link in place of the Victron/Ruuvi hardware nodes. On real hardware no link-out references it, so it stays idle and the victron-input-* nodes drive Collect Data directly — harmless to keep in the production flow.

name: Critical lock
🎨 Light palette — paste into the 'TinyHouse Dark' theme node to switch
info:
Dashboard 2.0 has no per-user light/dark toggle; the theme colours are fixed by the theme node. To switch the whole dashboard to light mode, set the 'TinyHouse Dark' theme colours to:

  surface:      #ffffff
  primary:      #0094ce
  bgPage:       #eef1f5
  groupBg:      #ffffff
  groupOutline: #d4dae3

(The current dark palette is surface #161c27, primary #4cc9f0, bgPage #0e131b, groupBg #1a2230, groupOutline #2b3851.)
